title: North trailhead — historic Bunce School (CO-7)
notes: 1888 schoolhouse at the highway junction. Trail runs 5.08 mi south to Peaceful Valley. MVUM: open yearlong, ATV open, high-clearance. Full-trail videos anchored here.

media.title: Offroad Fun on Bunce School Road (2019)

title: FR 115.1A — Bunce School Spur
notes: Right at the start heading south; dead-ends at private property within ~0.5 mi (4x4explore). MVUM: yearlong, 0.36 mi.

title: FR 217.1 — Cave Creek
notes: Heads toward Highway 72 (4x4explore). Not maintained for passenger cars.

title: FR 216.1 — Ironclads (hard side trail)
notes: Significantly harder than Bunce proper — reports suggest lifted + 35s, steep ledges, spotter useful. Modeled as the 'ironclads' route in this bundle (switch routes to scrub it).

title: Hairpin #1 (rocky)
notes: 105-degree hairpin (geometry-detected). 4x4explore: rocky sections concentrate at the hairpins. Description-to-location mapping approximate.

title: Hairpin #2 (rocky, pick your line)
notes: 119-degree hairpin at mile ~2.65 (geometry-detected), coincides with the steep zone's south end.

title: Steepest sustained pitch (21% max grade, mile ~3.1)
notes: DEM-derived: steepest zone on the route. Obstacle candidate — top capture priority. Interesting: matches 4x4explore's 'rocky sections ~2/3 through' better than the hairpins do.

title: FR 202.1 — Upper Basin (Park Creek)
notes: Right intersection near the route's south end (4x4explore calls it Park Creek).

title: Descent switchback (upper)
notes: 138-degree turn starting the final descent to Peaceful Valley.

title: Descent switchback (lower) — roughest section
notes: 142-degree turn. 4x4explore: second hairpin 'much rougher', larger rocks, pick your line, just before crossing back near private property.

title: South trailhead — Peaceful Valley
notes: Camp Dick / Peaceful Valley campgrounds nearby; dispersed sites along the route's NE end.

title: T-33A crash site (1965)
notes: End of the crash trail path off FR 203.1 North Basin. Wreckage of a 1965 Air Force T-33 trainer crash; treat the site with respect — it is a memorial.

media.title: Wheeling Through History: the T-33 Crash Site (2023)
